info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Insurance Claims Claims Documents-v1-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Document Retrieval API enables users to access documents related to submitted insurance claims. This API allows for the efficient retrieval of all documents associated with specific claims, supporting effective claims management and audit processes. Typical consumers include claims adjusters, policyholders, and service representatives who need to access documentation for review or verification. By utilizing this API, organizations can streamline claims processing and improve customer service responsiveness.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all documents associated with claims. You can use this to retrieve specific details such as claim receipts, supporting documentation, or any other relevant files related to the claims process.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving claim documents in JSON format. The body must contain the necessary parameters to specify the claim for which documents are being requested.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the list of documents.
